central_data_line.relationship: V2 and V3-R1 form one coherent DATA line. R1 is an internal replication/extension with fresh seeds and corrected multiple-testing implementation; it is not independent scientific replication.
central_data_line.claim_boundary: Topology-sensitive propagation is supported only in the preregistered 64-neuron/246-edge Small-SNN operating envelope. No 5D superiority, scaling, cognition, biological equivalence or independent replication is established.

second_functional_line.independence_semantics: Independent in functional question/task, not an independent replication of the topology claim.
second_functional_line.claim_boundary: Scoped technical temporal-order function of a six-neuron acyclic SNN under the registered decoder/task. No learning, memory, cognition, scaling, biological equivalence, 5D advantage or independent replication is established.

evid_promotion_assessment.scope: Stage-1 topology and temporal-order DATA remain DATA after accepted interpretation reviews.
reasons: No canonical Stage-1 claim ID is registered for EvidenceEngine promotion of these scoped results.
The historical experiment manifests predate the current promotion provenance contract and must not be retroactively rewritten.
The completed reviews are accepted_as_interpretation artifacts, not canonical EvidenceEngine human_review.json decisions in the supports/refutes/inconclusive schema.
evid_promotion_assessment.required_next_step: Define a separate scoped claim and prospective promotion-eligible execution/review path before any Stage-1 EVID registration.

independent_replication.requirement: Independently controlled and independently authored/audited preregistered replication.

stronger_claims_kept_separate.note: The Stage-1 baseline does not establish a 5D advantage.
